title: liveness ledger: action.onSuccess.navigate / openIn and translation.flows.screens are graded planned, but objectui already reads all three at the pinned sha
body:
Filing gate: **① a ledger verdict that is wrong on measurement.** Three rows say `planned`, but a shipped reader exists in objectui at the `.objectui-sha` pin this repo builds against. The ledger UNDERSTATES them, so `os lint`'s planned-row warning is a false alarm to authors who write these keys.
- `reach:` named readers. The seat read each one at the pin `f8a9d0fb0596`; the #18900 ④ census also read them at objectui `main` `6fa5f64a1`.
  - `action.onSuccess.navigate` / `action.onSuccess.openIn` (`packages/spec/liveness/action.json:201`, `:207`): objectui `packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts`. The path is `readOnSuccessNavigation` → `navigateOnSuccess` (`:1447` at the pin), entered at `:1415`; it reads `block.navigate` (`:1457`) and `block.openIn`.
  - `translation.flows.screens` (`packages/spec/liveness/translation.json:106`): objectui `packages/app-shell/src/views/FlowRunner.tsx:227`, `bundle[language]?.flows?.[flowName]?.screens?.[…]`. The census reports it mounted at `app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx` and `apps/console/src/pages/developer/FlowRunsPage.tsx`.
  - `translation.flows.label` has NO reader (census C14). It stays `planned` and is family card rank 15 (`translation-flow-label`), not this card.

Found by the #18900 ④ per-family census (finding 2). Filed by the `domain:spec` execution seat 1 (`session_01Rjy9MeetSfq34PKn81CRiN`, seat post #6017). ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What the fix is (for the dispatch to confirm)

- Re-verify each row to `live`, citing `objectui @<pin>` with file and symbol, plus the producer leg the ledger's rules require. The `onSuccess` pair has a materialized `.default('self')` on `openIn`, which the row's own note discusses.
- Drop any `authorWarn` the `planned` status carried, and regenerate `state-counts.md`. `pnpm check:liveness` stays green.
- Each row's note records why it was `planned` (the #9340 / #9463 spec-first convention) and what flipped it: the reader landed and the pin absorbed it. #4848's flip note in `app.json` is the precedent shape.

## Dedupe

A local scan of every open and recently closed objectstack issue and PR for `onSuccess.(navigate|openIn)|flows.screens|navigateOnSuccess` finds 3 hits: two seat posts and #19678 (closed, unrelated). None carries these rows.
